jobs.title: Director, Data Analytics
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Data Analytics based in Canada.

We are looking for an experienced data and analytics leader to drive the successful activation, monitoring, and optimization of AI-powered solutions for enterprise clients. In this strategic leadership role, you will oversee a high-performing team of data scientists and analysts while shaping the programs that connect AI model performance with measurable business outcomes. You will lead complex client onboarding initiatives, establish scalable performance monitoring frameworks, and develop advanced analytics and experimentation capabilities. Working closely with Machine Learning Engineers, Support teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will ensure that AI solutions deliver tangible value and continuously improve over time. This is an exciting opportunity to combine technical expertise, people leadership, and program management within a fast-paced, innovation-driven technology environment.

Accountabilities

Lead, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of Data Scientists and Analysts responsible for measuring, monitoring, and evaluating sophisticated AI model pipelines.
Oversee day-to-day team management, providing technical guidance, coaching, performance feedback, and long-term career development opportunities.
Drive the strategic planning and execution of AI client onboarding programs, ensuring smooth coordination and successful deployment across the client portfolio.
Develop and implement scalable frameworks to monitor client portfolio performance, AI model effectiveness, business impact, and return on investment.
Automate performance tracking, reporting, and diagnostic processes to improve operational efficiency and provide consistent visibility into AI-driven business outcomes.
Establish rigorous analytical standards and ensure the delivery of accurate, reliable, and actionable insights across all team initiatives.
Design and implement comprehensive performance reporting and diagnostic playbooks that equip Support teams with the tools and insights needed to address client questions and demonstrate AI performance.
Lead the investigation and resolution of complex performance escalations, collaborating closely with Machine Learning Engineers and other technical teams to identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
Oversee the development and deployment of commercial-grade tracking, observability, and experimentation solutions that improve transparency and enable continuous AI optimization.
Translate model performance data and technical findings into scalable reporting frameworks and experimentation strategies that demonstrate measurable client value.
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, and Client Support teams to align priorities, streamline workflows, and improve the overall AI activation process.
Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, analytical methodologies, and industry best practices to strengthen the organization's capabilities and maintain a competitive advantage.
Communicate program progress, performance insights, operational challenges, and strategic recommendations to internal stakeholders and senior leadership.

Requirements

At least 7 years of combined experience in data analytics, technical program management, and leadership, ideally involving the measurement and monitoring of complex AI or machine learning model pipelines.
Demonstrated experience recruiting, developing, and leading technical teams, with strong people management skills and the ability to mentor data scientists and analysts.
Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
Proven program management expertise, including the ability to coordinate complex client onboarding initiatives, manage multiple priorities, and deliver projects within demanding timelines.
Strong technical proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience working with cloud data platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), BigQuery, AWS, or Amazon Redshift.
Advanced proficiency in Tableau, including the ability to develop sophisticated dashboards, performance reports, and data visualization solutions.
Strong understanding of the AI and machine learning model lifecycle, from initial discovery and experimentation through production deployment, performance monitoring, and ongoing evaluation.
Experience with statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and performance measurement methodologies, particularly for recommendation systems and propensity scoring models.
Ability to design and implement scalable monitoring, observability, diagnostics, and experimentation frameworks for deployed AI solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret complex performance data and translate findings into actionable business recommendations.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain sophisticated technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, client-facing teams, and cross-functional partners.
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a consistent focus on analytical accuracy, operational excellence, and high-quality delivery.
Proven ability to manage complex escalations, coordinate technical investigations, and drive issues toward timely and sustainable resolution.
Adaptability and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving technology environment with multiple concurrent initiatives.
Curiosity and a continuous learning mindset, with a strong interest in emerging AI technologies, machine learning advancements, and innovative analytical approaches.
Collaborative leadership style, with the ability to build strong relationships and align multidisciplinary teams around shared objectives.

Benefits

Competitive annual base salary ranging from CAD $225,000 to $290,000, depending on qualifications, relevant experience, technical expertise, and the final scope of the position.
Potential additional bonus, depending on the position ultimately offered.
Comprehensive medical and healthcare benefits.
Financial benefits and additional employee programs.
Other benefits and incentives as part of a competitive total compensation package.
Remote working opportunity based in Canada.
Opportunity to lead and develop a talented team of data scientists and analysts.
Exposure to cutting-edge AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, and data-driven marketing technologies.
Opportunity to influence the development of scalable AI monitoring, experimentation, and performance optimization solutions.
Inclusive and collaborative work environment that values diverse perspectives, professional development, and innovation.
Equal employment opportunities and a commitment to building a diverse workplace where individuals from all backgrounds can thrive.

jobs.title: Director, Solutions Architecture
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Solutions Architecture based in Canada.

We are seeking an experienced technology leader to transform and scale a Solutions Architecture function within a global learning technology organization. In this strategic yet highly operational role, you will lead the evolution from traditional integration coordination to an engineering-driven team capable of designing, building, and maintaining scalable integration solutions. You will define the technical strategy, oversee integration architecture, and establish reusable frameworks that improve delivery efficiency and customer experience. Working across Product, Engineering, Partnerships, Presales, and Customer Support, you will drive operational excellence while balancing resources and priorities across a combined technology portfolio. You will also lead team development, introduce modern engineering standards, and leverage AI-assisted development to accelerate innovation. This is an opportunity to shape a growing technical organization and deliver meaningful impact within a globally distributed, AI-driven technology environment.

Accountabilities

Lead the transformation of the Solutions Architecture function from a technical intake and third-party coordination team into an engineering-focused organization that directly designs, develops, and maintains strategic integrations.
Define the integration strategy and establish clear criteria for determining which solutions should be developed and maintained internally versus delivered through external partners.
Own the integration roadmap and prioritization process in collaboration with Product, Engineering, Partnerships, and Customer Support teams.
Manage technical capacity, resource allocation, and workload distribution across the combined technology portfolios, ensuring projects are delivered efficiently and aligned with business priorities.
Establish and develop the Workato integration platform foundation, creating standardized architecture, reusable components, and adaptable custom solutions that can be deployed across multiple customers.
Introduce engineering best practices into integration development, including software development lifecycle (SDLC) processes, technical design reviews, code reviews, testing standards, and documentation.
Take ownership of existing third-party integrations across both platforms, assessing their architecture, performance, documentation, and long-term sustainability to determine which should be retained, migrated internally, or retired.
Manage inherited codebases and external technology partners, ensuring appropriate technical governance, quality standards, and ongoing operational accountability.
Recruit, develop, and mentor a high-performing Solutions Architecture team, strengthening technical capabilities and building an engineering culture focused on quality, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Introduce AI-assisted development practices thoughtfully, helping the team improve productivity while maintaining strong engineering fundamentals, code quality, and responsible management of AI usage and associated costs.
Redesign operational workflows, including project intake, Jira processes, delivery coordination, and collaboration models with Product, Partnerships, Presales, and Customer Support.
Establish clear operational processes and train Support teams to resolve or redirect development-related requests effectively, reducing unnecessary engineering escalations.
Own the ongoing operational performance of internally developed integrations, including monitoring, maintenance, version control, service levels, and incident management.
Ensure all integration solutions meet applicable security, contractual, and data privacy requirements, acting as the senior escalation point for complex or high-risk technical issues.
Partner with Presales teams during early-stage technical discovery, solution design, project estimation, and scope definition, while overseeing the technical handoff from Sales to delivery.
Collaborate with AI Innovation and Solutions leadership to evaluate the transition of successful pilots into Professional Services delivery and streamline operational processes.
Manage technical service offerings, utilization, project tracking, pricing, statements of work (SOWs), and delivery margins.
Develop and monitor performance metrics that demonstrate the impact of the function on deal size, time to production, customer retention, delivery quality, and operational efficiency.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase integration reusability, accelerate implementation timelines, and strengthen the overall customer experience.

Requirements

At least 8 years of professional experience in Solutions Architecture, Technical Professional Services, Integration Consulting, or a related technical leadership field.
Strong expertise in API integration technologies and architectures, including REST, SOAP, and GraphQL, as well as cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Proven experience leading, hiring, developing, and managing technical teams, ideally within globally distributed organizations.
Demonstrated ability to manage technical delivery functions, including resource planning, capacity management, utilization tracking, project prioritization, and cross-functional workflows.
Hands-on experience building scalable, reusable, and productized integrations using an Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) solution.
Strong understanding of integration architecture principles, with the ability to design standardized frameworks and reusable components that can be adapted to different customer requirements.
Experience applying engineering standards to integration delivery, including SDLC methodologies, technical design reviews, code reviews, testing practices, and quality assurance.
Proven ability to modernize technical teams and establish engineering-driven delivery processes, including coaching team members to adopt new tools, standards, and development methodologies.
Experience taking ownership of inherited or third-party-developed software, assessing technical quality, and making informed build-versus-buy, partner, migration, and modernization decisions.
Strong vendor and partner management capabilities, including the ability to coordinate external providers, evaluate deliverables, and maintain technical and commercial accountability.
Direct experience supporting technical Presales activities, including client discovery, solution scoping, effort estimation, technical proposals, and SOW development.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and influence decisions across engineering teams, business leaders, and executive stakeholders.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience with Workato is highly desirable. Familiarity with other iPaaS platforms, such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Jitterbit, or Tray.io, is also valuable.
Experience integrating enterprise systems, including Single Sign-On (SSO), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Human Resources Information Systems (HRIS), and Learning Management Systems (LMS/LXP).
Previous experience integrating technical teams, codebases, platforms, or service portfolios following a merger or acquisition is considered an asset.
Proficiency in SQL and data analytics, with the ability to leverage operational data to guide technical decisions and measure delivery performance.
Strong organizational and strategic thinking skills, combined with a hands-on approach to execution and problem-solving.
Adaptability and comfort operating in a rapidly evolving technology environment, managing multiple priorities while building processes and structures where they do not yet exist.

Benefits

Competitive annual base salary ranging from CAD $175,000 to $218,000, depending on experience, qualifications, location, and relevant technical expertise.
Potential eligibility for additional variable compensation.
Equity compensation opportunities, subject to the applicable compensation package.
Comprehensive employee benefits package.
Flexible working arrangements, with the freedom to work remotely, from an office, or from collaborative workspaces.
Opportunity to work within a globally distributed organization serving millions of learners and thousands of enterprise customers.
Exposure to advanced technologies, including AI-powered learning solutions, automation, cloud platforms, and enterprise integration systems.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering - VieFund
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Engineering – VieFund based in Canada.

We are seeking an experienced, hands-on engineering leader to take full technical ownership of a well-established financial technology platform serving Canada's wealth management and investment dealer industry. In this role, you will oversee the platform's architecture, software development, database infrastructure, integrations, and production operations while leading its long-term modernization. You will work closely with an established engineering team across Canada and Vietnam, ensuring business continuity while driving the transition from legacy on-premises infrastructure to modern cloud-based solutions. A key priority will be maintaining critical financial operations, including mutual fund transactions, settlements, account bookkeeping, and regulatory reporting, while introducing AI-assisted development practices. Combining deep technical expertise with independent decision-making and strong customer relationships, you will shape the platform's next phase of growth. This is an opportunity to lead the evolution of a profitable, mission-critical financial software product within a long-term, technology-focused investment environment.

Accountabilities

Take full technical ownership of the platform, overseeing software architecture, codebase management, database infrastructure, development processes, releases, and production operations.
Build a comprehensive understanding of the existing product, customer configurations, business workflows, and technical architecture through close collaboration with established engineering teams in Ottawa and Vietnam.
Develop and maintain detailed technical documentation covering system behavior, dealer-specific configurations, integrations, operational procedures, and troubleshooting runbooks.
Maintain, enhance, and oversee critical FundServ integrations, including annual standards upgrades, certification processes, transaction processing, and reconciliation activities.
Diagnose and resolve complex integration issues involving external vendors, financial institutions, fund providers, and other industry counterparties.
Design, develop, and maintain core transaction processing, account bookkeeping, settlement, distribution, correction, and reporting functionality, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and auditability.
Serve as the final technical escalation point for customer-facing incidents, investigating root causes, communicating solutions, and implementing sustainable corrective measures.
Ensure uninterrupted platform operations throughout critical industry periods, including tax season, RRSP and RRIF deadlines, year-end activities, and regulatory or industry standards changes.
Define and execute the technical roadmap, prioritizing platform stability, architectural improvements, infrastructure modernization, and enhanced customer value.
Lead the migration from legacy on-premises infrastructure to cloud-based environments, developing a carefully sequenced transition plan that minimizes operational disruption and protects customer data.
Manage production environments across hosted infrastructure and client-managed Windows Server deployments, including server provisioning, maintenance, patching, backups, security, monitoring, and uptime.
Introduce modern software engineering practices, improving development workflows, code quality, testing, deployment processes, and operational resilience.
Champion the adoption of AI-assisted development tools, integrating practical AI capabilities into engineering workflows to improve productivity, code quality, and delivery efficiency.
Collaborate with hosting providers, financial dealers, external technology partners, and internal stakeholders to ensure reliable service delivery and effective technical communication.
Lead knowledge transfer and technical continuity, reducing reliance on undocumented processes and ensuring critical product knowledge is shared across the engineering team.
Recruit, develop, mentor, and manage engineers and contractors as the technical organization evolves.
Establish clear engineering standards, promote accountability, and encourage independent problem-solving within the team.
Plan and coordinate technical activities around customer business hours and industry deadlines, including occasional evening and weekend work when required.
Work closely with senior engineering leadership to align technical priorities with broader business objectives and long-term product development plans.

Requirements

Extensive professional experience in software engineering, technical leadership, or software architecture, preferably within financial technology, wealth management, investment platforms, or financial services.
Deep, hands-on experience with FundServ integrations, including annual standards upgrades, certification, transaction troubleshooting, and resolving complex issues involving external vendors and fund providers.
Strong understanding of mutual fund transaction accounting, including trades, settlements, distributions, account bookkeeping, corrections, and financial reporting.
Advanced technical expertise in .NET, Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL), and T-SQL, including the ability to develop, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize complex stored procedures, database scripts, and dealer-specific business logic.
Proven experience managing Windows Server environments, including server setup, patching, backups, security, maintenance, troubleshooting, and production support across hosted and client-managed infrastructure.
Demonstrated ability to take complete ownership of an established software platform, quickly understand complex legacy systems, and make independent technical decisions.
Experience leading or contributing to large-scale software modernization initiatives, particularly migrating on-premises applications and infrastructure to cloud environments, is highly desirable.
Strong knowledge of software architecture, database design, application development, production deployments, system integrations, and operational reliability.
Experience managing business-critical software systems where data accuracy, auditability, uptime, and regulatory or industry requirements are essential.
Proven ability to diagnose complex technical incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement durable solutions in environments involving multiple external dependencies.
Strong understanding of the Canadian financial services or wealth management industry, ideally through experience with dealer platforms, back-office systems, transfer agency solutions, or investment administration software.
Familiarity with the FIX protocol, particularly in relation to exchange-traded fund (ETF) operations, is considered an asset.
Practical experience using AI-powered coding assistants and development tools as part of daily engineering activities, with the ability to introduce and scale these practices within an established codebase.
Experience leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, coordinating contractors, and managing knowledge transfer across distributed teams.
Excellent communication and relationship management skills, with the ability to work effectively with investment dealers, external partners, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
Strong independent judgment, accountability, and problem-solving abilities, particularly when managing critical technical decisions without extensive supervision.
A collaborative, approachable, and customer-focused mindset, with the ability to build trust and maintain productive relationships during high-pressure situations.
Alignment with values of humility, honesty, continuous learning, ownership, and long-term thinking.
Ability to work remotely in Canada and travel to Ottawa and/or Toronto when required.
Availability to work in Ottawa at least every two weeks during the first six months to support onboarding, in-person knowledge transfer, and technical transition.
Flexibility to occasionally work evenings and weekends, particularly during seasonal peaks and critical dealer processing periods.

Benefits

Opportunity to take full technical ownership of an established and profitable financial technology platform.
Remote-first working arrangement within Canada.
Opportunity to work with established engineering teams across Ottawa, Toronto, and Vietnam.
Direct collaboration with experienced engineering leadership and access to broader technical expertise and support.
Significant influence over the platform's technical strategy, architecture, modernization, and long-term development.
Opportunity to lead a major cloud migration and introduce AI-assisted engineering practices into an established software environment.
Exposure to the Canadian wealth management and investment industry, including critical financial transaction and reporting infrastructure.
Long-term product development mandate focused on sustainable growth, customer value, and continuous improvement.
Opportunity to build and develop an engineering team while strengthening technical knowledge sharing and operational capabilities.

jobs.title: Director, Operations
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director, Operations based in Canada.

We are seeking an experienced and strategically minded Director of Operations to lead and optimize the organization's IT infrastructure, distribution, logistics, and fulfillment operations across Canada and the United States. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will take ownership of end-to-end operational performance, overseeing everything from warehouse networks and transportation strategy to enterprise systems, data integrity, and inventory management. Combining executive-level leadership with hands-on operational involvement, you will drive efficiency, strengthen external partnerships, and ensure reliable fulfillment across eCommerce, retail, and wholesale channels. You will also champion AI-driven automation, modernize data infrastructure, and establish scalable processes that support sustainable business growth. Working closely with cross-functional teams and external service providers, you will play a critical role in improving operational performance, controlling costs, and enhancing the customer experience. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of operations within a fast-paced, technology-driven retail environment.

Accountabilities

Lead and execute the overall distribution and fulfillment strategy across eCommerce, retail, and wholesale channels throughout Canada and the United States.
Oversee the complete product distribution lifecycle, from factory handoff and inbound transportation to warehouse receiving, inventory movement, and final delivery to customers, retail stores, and wholesale partners.
Monitor fulfillment performance and continuously improve service levels, operational reliability, capacity planning, and cost efficiency across the distribution network.
Lead peak-season preparation, operational readiness, and contingency planning to ensure business continuity during periods of increased demand.
Develop and manage the freight, parcel, and transportation strategy, including carrier selection, rate negotiations, commercial agreements, and service performance.
Oversee inbound freight operations, customs procedures, brokerage relationships, and cross-border logistics, ensuring compliance and efficient movement of goods.
Identify and manage logistics cost-recovery opportunities, including duty drawback programs and other transportation-related savings initiatives.
Own fulfillment economics, including warehouse expenses, freight, parcel delivery, storage, and overall cost-to-serve, establishing visibility into cost per order and cost per unit.
Identify and implement cost-reduction initiatives, review major logistics invoices, resolve commercial discrepancies, and collaborate with Finance on budgets, accruals, and operational cost reporting.
Manage inventory flow between warehouses, retail locations, and sales channels in close collaboration with Demand and Inventory Planning teams.
Ensure accurate and timely inbound inventory receiving, identify potential stock movement constraints, and implement solutions before they affect product availability.
Lead returns and reverse logistics operations, improving processing speed, cost efficiency, and the reintegration of returned products into available inventory.
Collaborate with eCommerce, Customer Experience, and Product teams to resolve operational challenges related to returns and customer experience.
Act as the business owner for IT and operational system requirements across NetSuite, Shopify, third-party logistics (3PL) platforms, electronic data interchange (EDI), warehouse management systems (WMS), retail systems, and carrier integrations.
Own the organization's end-to-end data infrastructure, including ERP administration, system integrations, data transfers, and information integrity across eCommerce, point-of-sale (POS), EDI, banking, warehouse, and returns platforms.
Establish robust data governance practices, including daily system variance monitoring, discrepancy investigation, root-cause analysis, and prevention of data inconsistencies.
Oversee IT infrastructure availability, uptime, and incident resolution, directing managed service providers (MSPs) on endpoint, network, and identity administration.
Drive AI-first transformation across IT and distribution by redesigning manual processes, implementing automation solutions, and scaling existing prototypes into reliable operational tools.
Establish comprehensive documentation for systems, workflows, standard operating procedures (SOPs), process ownership, and potential failure points to ensure transparency and operational continuity.
Manage AI-related expenditure through clear budgets, cost monitoring, and per-model usage visibility.
Build and maintain operational dashboards and lead the transition from legacy business intelligence tools to an AI-native analytics infrastructure with a centralized source of truth for business metrics.
Establish consistent performance measurement standards across Finance and commercial teams, ensuring alignment on reporting definitions and operational KPIs.
Define, monitor, and improve key performance indicators, including fulfillment service-level agreements (SLAs), shipping accuracy, receiving speed, carrier performance, inventory accuracy, and logistics costs.
Lead regular performance reviews, investigate recurring operational issues, and ensure corrective actions are implemented and sustained.
Own strategic and commercial relationships with 3PL providers, warehouses, carriers, freight forwarders, customs partners, and other critical logistics suppliers.
Manage external IT partners and software vendors, overseeing service agreements, deliverables, renewals, spending, and performance expectations.
Lead contract negotiations, commercial reviews, rate discussions, and senior-level escalations, ensuring external partners consistently meet agreed service standards.
Build and lead the IT, Logistics, and Fulfillment team, providing clear direction, coaching, and performance management while remaining actively involved in important operational decisions.
Develop accountability, problem-solving capabilities, and effective escalation practices within the team, empowering managers to oversee daily operations independently.
Collaborate closely with Demand Planning, Finance, eCommerce, Retail, Wholesale, Product, and Technology teams to align operational priorities with broader business objectives.

Requirements

Extensive experience in senior operations leadership, preferably within eCommerce, retail, distribution, logistics, or other technology-enabled businesses.
Proven track record managing end-to-end distribution, fulfillment, and logistics operations across multiple channels and geographic markets, ideally including Canada and the United States.
Strong understanding of third-party logistics (3PL), warehouse management, freight forwarding, parcel transportation, customs brokerage, and cross-border distribution.
Demonstrated experience negotiating commercial agreements, managing external vendors, optimizing carrier relationships, and holding logistics and technology partners accountable for service performance.
Solid financial and commercial acumen, including experience managing operational budgets, fulfillment costs, cost-to-serve models, vendor expenses, and cost-reduction initiatives.
Experience overseeing inventory management, warehouse receiving, inventory transfers, returns processing, and reverse logistics operations.
Strong knowledge of enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems and eCommerce platforms, particularly NetSuite and Shopify, as well as WMS, EDI, POS, and third-party system integrations.
Experience managing IT infrastructure and external managed service providers, including network administration, endpoint management, identity systems, uptime, and incident resolution.
Demonstrated expertise in data infrastructure, system integration, data governance, and maintaining accurate and consistent information across multiple business platforms.
Strong analytical capabilities, with experience developing operational dashboards, defining KPIs, implementing reporting frameworks, and driving performance improvements through data-driven decision-making.
Familiarity with business intelligence platforms and emerging AI-native analytics solutions, with the ability to lead technology modernization initiatives.
A strong interest in AI-powered automation and practical experience identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, reduce manual processes, and improve operational efficiency.
Ability to govern AI-related spending, assess technology investments, and ensure automation solutions deliver measurable business value.
Proven experience developing operational SOPs, documenting system architecture, establishing process ownership, and implementing continuous improvement frameworks.
Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to develop high-performing teams, coach managers, delegate effectively, and establish clear accountability.
Hands-on leadership approach, combining strategic planning with the ability to engage directly in complex operational issues and high-priority decisions.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Finance, Technology, Supply Chain, eCommerce, Retail, and other business functions.
Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis capabilities, with a proactive approach to identifying operational risks and implementing sustainable solutions.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining operational consistency, service quality, and business continuity.

Benefits

Competitive annual salary ranging from CAD $170,000 to $190,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
Full-time remote working arrangement based in Vancouver, British Columbia.
Senior leadership opportunity with direct reporting to the CEO.
Significant ownership and influence over the organization's operational strategy, technology infrastructure, logistics network, and fulfillment performance.
Opportunity to lead AI-driven transformation initiatives and modernize enterprise systems and data infrastructure.
Exposure to a dynamic, growing eCommerce and retail environment operating across Canada and the United States.
Opportunity to build and develop a high-performing operations team while working closely with senior leadership and cross-functional departments.
Strategic involvement in commercial negotiations, vendor partnerships, operational planning, and business performance optimization.

jobs.description:

Ensures the credit quality of the assigned portfolios are maintained within the Bank’s risk tolerance, policies & procedures, and meet financing guidelines. Supports credit adjudication operations and initiatives. Provides training and support to teams and channels where the applications and transactions originate.

Works with stakeholders to ensure effectiveness of risk management controls, analysis and monitoring on a transactional and portfolio basis.
Provides credit coaching, training and support to direct team and other stakeholders as required.
Provides strategic input into business decisions as a trusted advisor.
Makes recommendations to senior leaders on strategy and new initiatives, based on an in-depth understanding of the business/group.

Influences and negotiates to achieve business objectives.
Identifies emerging issues and trends to inform decision-making.
Recommends business priorities, advises on resource requirements and develops roadmap for strategic execution.
Manages resources and leads the execution of strategic initiatives to deliver on business and financial goals.
Conducts independent analysis and assessment to resolve strategic issues.
Acts as the prime subject matter expert for internal/external stakeholders.
Ensures alignment between stakeholders.

If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

The Deputy Head of After-Sales is responsible for leading Geely's national aftersales business across Canada, covering parts, service, technical support, CRM and warranty. The position serves as the key link between Geely headquarters and the dealer network, driving customer satisfaction and aftersales growth in the Canadian market.

Key Responsibilities

(1) Lead and execute the national aftersales strategy, provide professional reference suggestions for the development of the Company's overseas business, and conduct research on industry trends to output implementable reference plans.
(2) Drive aftersales revenue, profitability and customer retention; establish KPIs and performance frameworks across the dealer network, including parts revenue, workshop productivity, warranty cost control and customer satisfaction.
(3) Lead the parts and accessories business, ensuring availability, competitive pricing and dealer profitability; optimise supply chain, demand forecasting and inventory planning.
(4) Establish technical support, training and escalation capabilities across the dealer network; monitor field quality and coordinate corrective actions with global engineering teams.
(5) Develop national service standards and operating procedures; lead CRM strategy across the ownership lifecycle and continuously improve CSI and NPS through customer feedback.
(6) Oversee warranty policy, claims management and cost control in compliance with global standards; establish scalable aftersales systems and processes to support network expansion.
(7) Track project progress and output progress summary reports to management and Headquarters; build and lead a high-performing aftersales organisation and collaborate with Sales, Network Development, Product, Finance and global teams.

Job Requirements

● Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, or related field; MBA preferred.
● 10+ years of automotive aftersales experience (parts, service, technical, warranty or CRM), with 5+ years in a senior leadership role.
● Deep understanding of the Canadian automotive aftermarket and dealer operations.
● Strong P&L, budgeting and dealer network management capabilities.
● Bilingual English/French is an asset; Mandarin Chinese is a plus.
● Valid Canadian driver's license and willingness to travel across Canada.
● Eligibility to work in Canada.

Husky TechnologiesTM a company with a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships, a strong sense of community and a unique culture and values. We are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy.

We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM Canadian manufacturing facilities and global headquarters are located in Bolton, Ontario on a large, beautiful campus located just 20 minutes north of Toronto’s Pearson International Airport. Features include a fitness and wellness center, intramural sports activities, on-site cafeteria, and clean, state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities with outstanding safety records. We offer a great work environment and competitive total compensation package, including above market retirement savings plan and market competitive group benefits.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Director / GM, Global Marketing & Sales Enablement
is responsible for defining and driving Husky's global brand strategy, leading B2B marketing and demand generation, advancing sustainability advocacy and industry engagement, delivering actionable market intelligence, and improving global sales effectiveness.

Reporting to the EVP, Sales & Marketing, this leader will strengthen Husky's market position and industry influence, build an integrated commercial support function, and connect market insights, customer engagement, and sales capabilities to deliver measurable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Global Brand Strategy, Marketing & Industry Advocacy
Own Husky's global brand strategy, positioning, identity, and differentiation, ensuring a compelling and consistent presence across markets and customer touchpoints.
Develop and execute global B2B marketing programs that generate qualified leads and commercial opportunities through digital channels, integrated campaigns, account-based marketing, trade shows, and customer events.
Lead Husky's sustainability advocacy and industry engagement strategy, partnering with industry associations, customers, and value-chain stakeholders to advance science-based understanding of plastics, address misconceptions, and promote responsible use, recycling, and circularity.
Represent Husky's perspectives in relevant industry initiatives and advocacy programs, strengthening its reputation as a credible technology leader and constructive voice in sustainability discussions.
Establish metrics to evaluate brand strength, marketing contribution to pipeline, and the reach and effectiveness of advocacy initiatives.
Market Intelligence & Strategic Insights
Lead a centralized market intelligence and research capability serving Sales, Product Line Management, Strategy, Investor Relations, and executive leadership.
Deliver actionable insights on market trends, competitive dynamics, customer needs, sustainability-related market developments, and emerging growth opportunities.
Support strategic planning, market prioritization, product portfolio decisions, and commercial growth initiatives.
Establish systematic approaches to market research, competitive intelligence, and voice-of-customer analysis.
Strategic Customer Engagement & Sales Enablement
Lead the development of executive-level content and strategic narratives for Top-to-Top (T2T) customer meetings, supporting senior leadership and strategic account engagement.
Develop high-impact sales enablement content, including value propositions, product and solution presentations, competitive positioning, case studies, and customer value tools.
Partner with Sales, Product Line Management, and Engineering to ensure differentiated, consistent, and customer-focused messaging.
Equip global commercial teams with the content, knowledge, and capabilities required to engage customers effectively and win business.
Sales Effectiveness & Commercial Excellence
Partner with Sales leadership to improve sales productivity, commercial processes, opportunity management, and overall sales effectiveness.
Drive adoption of sales methodologies, CRM capabilities, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to strengthen commercial execution.
Develop scalable approaches to sales training, onboarding, best-practice sharing, and continuous improvement of capability.
Establish performance metrics and improvement initiatives focused on sales efficiency, conversion rates, win rates, and commercial productivity.

Leadership & Experience

The successful candidate will be a strategic, commercially oriented leader with proven experience in global brand management, complex industrial B2B marketing, market intelligence, and sales enablement.

Experience engaging industry associations, building external partnerships, and shaping industry narratives around sustainability, circularity, or related topics is highly desirable.

The role requires strong business acumen, the ability to lead global multidisciplinary teams, and the credibility to influence executive stakeholders while translating market insights and brand strategy into measurable commercial outcomes.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or other advanced business degree considered an asset
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in global B2B marketing, brand strategy, commercial excellence, or sales enablement within a complex industrial, manufacturing, technology, or capital equipment environment
Demonstrated success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive brand growth, lead generation, customer engagement, and measurable commercial results across global markets.
Proven experience leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and voice-of-customer research to influence business strategy, portfolio decisions, and growth initiatives.
Strong track record leading cross-functional and global teams, influencing executive stakeholders, and driving adoption of sales methodologies, CRM platforms, digital tools, and AI-enabled solutions to improve sales effectiveness.

Vacancy: Replacement

Pay Range: $150,000.00 - 185,000.00
